messages.content: What key signature does C# major have?

message.content:
**C♯ major** has a key signature of **seven sharps**:

| Sharp | Note |
|-------|------|
| F♯   | F♯   |
| C♯   | C♯   |
| G♯   | G♯   |
| D♯   | D♯   |
| A♯   | A♯   |
| E♯   | E♯   |
| B♯   | B♯   |

(These are the same as the key signature of D♭ major, which has five flats, but C♯ major is written with sharps.)
